item.title: Initech launches Initech Copilot, an AI analyst for embedded dashboards
item.description: Initech Cloud launched Initech Copilot, letting end users ask questions of embedded dashboards in natural language. Copilot is available as an add-on for $15 per user per month.

item.title: Initech Cloud achieves SOC 2 Type II
item.description: Initech Cloud completed its SOC 2 Type II audit with zero exceptions.
